tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Place 2 to 5 products side by side in a fixed dimension order. Missing values remain 暂无数据; no winner or recommendation is produced.

tools.name: get_brand
tools.description: Return brand registry aggregates: product count, complete-profile count, category distribution, price bands and per-platform social coverage. Brand names are platform names; no alias merging is performed.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Return the latest stored price and the plain product-page URL. This is a stored snapshot, not a real-time quote.

tools.name: get_price_change
tools.description: Return 180-day stored price statistics: current price, low, high, average, sample count and the current position within the recorded range. History only; no forecast.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Return the complete product dossier. The nine display sections are always present in fixed order; a missing section keeps its title and status no_data with 暂无数据.

tools.name: get_sub_category_brief
tools.description: Return a structured brief for one leaf category, or one brief per leaf under a parent category. Includes scale, price distribution, brand concentration, pain points and selling points; every figure carries a numerator, denominator and as_of.

tools.name: get_top100
tools.description: Return the platform public ranking order for a leaf category, or one list per leaf under a parent category. limit is 1-100 and offset paginates each list. Items are never scored or re-sorted.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the fixed leaf-category registry grouped by parent category. Each leaf carries the product count, complete-profile count and last update time. Use the returned category_id or subcategory_id with the other tools.

tools.name: request
tools.description: Return product data by ASIN or Amazon product URL with optional field filters. Set live=true to append a live price and stock snapshot.

tools.name: scrap_page
tools.description: Fetch a live product-page snapshot for price, stock, Buy Box seller, rating and review count. Pass an ASIN or an Amazon product URL. The response carries data_as_of and is_stale.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Literal substring search over product title, brand name and model number. Optional category, price and rating filters and explicit sort orders are supported. Natural-language and similarity search are not supported.
